editorial:
Imagine trying to start a new life based on honesty, only to realize your own parents are total disasters. That is exactly where you find Greg in this wild ride. After shutting down his lying service to be a better man for Flo, he thinks he is finally in the clear. But when it comes time to meet the parents before the big proposal, he realizes his real family is way too crazy to be seen in public. The vibe is total chaos from start to finish, as Greg has to bring back his old team to create the biggest lie of his life. It is a loud, colorful, and fast movie that feels like a giant party where everything goes wrong in the funniest way possible.

You will love how the pacing never slows down and how the jokes hit one after another. The acting is high-energy, though some of the gags might feel a bit over the top for some. If you like slapstick humor and crazy misunderstandings, this is right up your alley. For the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the physical comedy details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for movie nights with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head during a massive, chaotic dinner where the fake parents and real parents collide. After a series of wild accidents and loud arguments, the truth finally comes out. Flo discovers the elaborate lies, but she eventually forgives Greg because she sees how much he loves her. Greg learns that he cannot hide from his real family forever. They all find a weird kind of peace, and Greg and Flo finally get their happy ending together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies and chaotic family dynamics.
